blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Leylah Fernandez stunned Russian top seed Mirra Andreeva, 6-2, 7-5, to reach the semifinals of the Singapore Open on Friday night. The Canadian World No. 31, who has Filipino roots, advanced to her first tour-level semifinal this season, where she battles French Open runner-up Maja Chwalinska on Saturday.
